tools.name: areye_profile
tools.description: Show the business account this key belongs to: company name, billing contact, webhook URL and portal role. Areye API: GET /business/profile.

tools.name: areye_dashboard
tools.description: Show aggregate account metrics: trips, spend and active employees. Areye API: GET /business/dashboard.

tools.name: areye_list_billing_statements
tools.description: List the monthly billing statements for the account. Areye API: GET /business/billing/statements.

tools.name: areye_list_zones
tools.description: List the active Areye service zones (the cities and areas where bookings are possible). Pickup must fall inside a zone. Areye API: GET /business/zones.

tools.name: areye_list_vehicle_types
tools.description: List vehicle types with live pricing and availability. Prefer declaring parcel_size or parcel_weight_kg when booking. Areye API: GET /business/vehicle-types.

tools.name: areye_list_parcel_sizes
tools.description: List the live parcel size tiers with weight ranges, eligible vehicle types and rates. Read this before choosing parcel_size. Areye API: GET /business/parcel-sizes.

tools.name: areye_fare_estimate
tools.description: Price a trip before booking it. Uses the same calculator as areye_book_trip. This tool does not book anything. Areye API: GET /business/trip/fare-estimate.

tools.name: areye_list_trips
tools.description: List trips, newest first. Filter by month, reference, or a search over reference, passenger, address and your external_reference. Use test=0 to hide sandbox trips from live results. Areye API: GET /business/trips.

tools.name: areye_active_trips
tools.description: List trips that are in progress now. Areye API: GET /business/trips/active.

tools.name: areye_get_trip
tools.description: Get one trip with its receipt, route details and status. Areye API: GET /business/trips/{reference}.

tools.name: areye_list_batches
tools.description: List bulk delivery batches with the status of each stop. Areye API: GET /business/batches.

tools.name: areye_get_batch
tools.description: Get one bulk delivery batch with all of its stops. Areye API: GET /business/batches/{id}.

tools.name: areye_book_trip
tools.description: Book a ride or a parcel delivery. This charges the account wallet or credit limit and dispatches a driver. Call areye_fare_estimate first. Every booking needs your own external_reference; a retry with the same reference and body returns the first booking, not a second one. Areye API: POST /business/

tools.name: areye_cancel_trip
tools.description: Cancel a trip before pickup. The business pays no cancellation charge and the wallet charge is refunded. After pickup the API refuses with not_cancellable. Areye API: POST /business/trips/{reference}/cancel.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: areye_profile · Private data: areye_profile, areye_book_trip, areye_cancel_trip · Public sink: areye_profile, areye_book_trip, areye_cancel_trip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: areye_profile · Private data: areye_profile, areye_book_trip, areye_cancel_trip · Public sink: areye_profile, areye_book_trip, areye_cancel_trip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
